notes: Curated cases for the RTI-application (Right to Information Act, 2005) complaint-drafter scenario. Each case runs the actual Pydantic validator + citation-resolution + template-assembly pipeline in complaint_drafter.py -- nothing here is mocked. This scenario has no 'grounds' selection (there is exactly one kind of request it drafts) and no LLM call anywhere in the path.
